provenance.notes: File confidence is the lowest confidence of any claim in it; read the claims individually.

checksum.description: The 15-digit number taken as an integer is divisible by 97 (remainder 0, unlike IBAN-style ISO 7064 MOD 97-10 which expects remainder 1).

validation.normalize: Remove spaces; left-pad with zeros to 15 digits.
steps: Interpret all 15 digits as one integer.
To compute the control digits for a 13-digit body: control = (97 - ((body * 100) mod 97)) mod 97, written with two digits.

testVectors.note: synthetic, built with the algorithm above

claims.value: 15 digits: 9 enterprise, 4 establishment, 2 control; whole number divisible by 97
claims.note: From an open-source validator that cites ice.gov.ma guides; the official guide was not fetched. The implementation calls the ISO 7064 MOD 97-10 routine but accepts remainder 0, which its own documented example 001561191000066 confirms. The separate Identifiant Fiscal (IF) format was not researched.
